dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibiting high-contrast, light-colored perimeters with irregular, serrated edges. These perimeters define a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior fur to the light-toned ring boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the lateral flank. These blobs form a continuous networked lattice, particularly where individual ring structures intersect.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an irregular quadrilateral. A linear sequence of three smaller high-intensity blobs extends from this group toward the posterior.
